violations.why: The ISR can write v_fjord after fn_lagoon stores a value (line 26) but before fn_zenith reads it as an argument (line 12), losing the stored value.
The ISR can write v_fjord after fn_lagoon's write (line 26) but before fn_zenith reads it for the increment (line 17), corrupting the value used for the update.
The ISR can write v_fjord after fn_zenith reads it as an argument (line 12) but before fn_zenith writes the incremented result (line 17), causing an inconsistent update.
